sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Choose the correct instrumental or prepositional pronoun form
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильную форму творительного или предложного падежа

items.prompt: Мы говорим о _____. (We're talking about you. - informal)
Она танцует с _____. (She dances with him.)
items.hint: С takes instrumental. Third person adds н- after prepositions.
items.explanation: С + instrumental: он → им → ним (preposition triggers н-).

items.prompt: Я доволен _____. (I'm pleased with you. - formal/plural)

items.hint: О takes prepositional. Third person adds н-.
items.explanation: О + prepositional: они → них (preposition triggers н-).

minimalPairs.context: Я работаю с _____. (I work with her.)
minimalPairs.explanation: С + instrumental: она → ей → ней (preposition adds н-). Instrumental form.

minimalPairs.context: Я думаю о _____. (I'm thinking about her.)
minimalPairs.explanation: О + prepositional: она → ней. For она, instrumental and prepositional are both ней after a preposition.

minimalPairs.context: Он гуляет со _____. (He's walking with me.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He's walking with me. (со = с before мной)

minimalPairs.context: Все знают обо _____. (Everyone knows about me.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Everyone knows about me. (обо = о before мне)
minimalPairs.explanation: О/обо + prepositional: я → мне. The preposition о becomes обо before мне.

blanks: Она говорит о _____. (She's talking about him.)
Мы играем с _____. (We're playing with them.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Instrumental vs prepositional forms with prepositions
hints: О (about) + prepositional. Third person with н-.
С (with) + instrumental. Third person with н-.
explanations: О + prepositional: он → нём (preposition adds н-).
С + instrumental: они → ими → ними (preposition adds н-).

sets.title: Sort and Correct
sets.description: Sort pronoun forms by case and fix errors

errorCorrection.hint: С is a preposition. Third-person pronouns need н-.
errorCorrection.explanation: After preposition с: ей → ней. Always add н- to 3rd person after prepositions.

errorCorrection.hint: О is a preposition. Third-person pronouns need н-.
errorCorrection.explanation: After preposition о: их → них (prepositional with н-).
С + instrumental: я → мной (not мне, which is dative/prepositional).
Довольна + instrumental: ты → тобой (not тебя, which is gen/acc).

translation.hint: I = я, going = иду, with you = с тобой
Tell = расскажи, me = мне, about her = о ней
We = мы, proud = гордимся, them (instrumental, no preposition) = ими
translation.grammarFocus: гордиться + instrumental, no preposition so no н-

sets.title: Spot the Pattern
sets.description: Recognize instrumental and prepositional patterns across all pronouns
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите закономерности в творительном и предложном падежах

patternRecognition.sentence: с ним, с ней, с ними, у него, о нём, о них
patternRecognition.question: What do all these forms have in common?
options: They are 3rd person pronouns after prepositions (all have н-)
patternRecognition.answer: They are 3rd person pronouns after prepositions (all have н-)
patternRecognition.explanation: All 3rd person pronouns (он, она, они) add н- when they follow a preposition.

patternRecognition.sentence: мной, тобой, им, ей, нами, вами, ими
patternRecognition.question: These are all forms of which case?
patternRecognition.explanation: These are all instrumental forms. Used with с (with), за (behind), над (above), etc.

patternRecognition.sentence: обо мне, о тебе, о нём, о ней, о нас, о вас, о них
patternRecognition.question: Why does о change to обо before мне?
options: To avoid a difficult consonant cluster
patternRecognition.answer: To avoid a difficult consonant cluster
patternRecognition.explanation: О becomes обо before мне to make pronunciation easier. Similar to со (с + мной) and ко (к + мне).

blanks: Под _____ лежит ковёр. (A carpet lies under us.)
Они спорят о _____. (They're arguing about him.)
Все заботятся о _____. (Everyone takes care of you. - informal)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Various prepositions with instrumental and prepositional
hints: О (about) + prepositional, third person with н-.
С (with) + instrumental, third person with н-.
О (about) + prepositional. No н- for second person.
explanations: О + prepositional: он → нём (preposition adds н-).
С + instrumental: она → ей → ней (preposition adds н-).
О + prepositional: ты → тебе (н- rule only applies to 3rd person).

minimalPairs.context: Я работаю с _____. (I work with them.) - instrumental
minimalPairs.explanation: С + instrumental: они → ими → ними. Use instrumental after с.

minimalPairs.context: Я думаю о _____. (I think about them.) - prepositional
minimalPairs.explanation: О + prepositional: они → них. Use prepositional after о.

minimalPairs.context: Он доволен _____. (He's pleased with us.) - no preposition
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He's pleased with us. (no preposition before pronoun)

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: A final round covering all six cases of pronoun declension
sets.descriptionRussian: Финальный раунд: все шесть падежей местоимений

items.prompt: Мы уже забыли о _____. (We already forgot about it.)
items.hint: О (about) takes prepositional. Оно uses the same forms as он.
items.explanation: О + prepositional: оно → нём (same as он after prepositions).

items.prompt: Собака бежит за _____. (The dog is running after me.)
items.promptEnglish: The dog is running after me.

items.prompt: Давай поговорим о _____. (Let's talk about us.)
Она пришла вместе с _____. (She came together with you. - formal)
Кот спит между _____ и _____. (The cat sleeps between me and you.)
items.promptEnglish: The cat sleeps between me and you.
items.explanation: Между + instrumental: я → мной, ты → тобой.

items.prompt: Картина висит над _____. (The painting hangs above us.)
Он беспокоится о _____. (He worries about you. - informal)

errorCorrection.hint: С is a preposition. Third person needs н-.
Над is a preposition. Third person needs н-.
